screens.title: A constellation of small lights
screens.description: A large forest plate sets the scene beside an ability constellation. Choosing a node reveals its point cost and prerequisite; unlocking asks for confirmation.

screens.title: A quiet balance of found things
screens.description: A prominent forest illustration anchors a two-slot loadout. The player selects a slot, previews benefit and tradeoff, then explicitly confirms or cancels.

screens.title: Read the forest by its paths
screens.description: A full-height forest plate sits beside labeled waypoints with distinct filled-circle, diamond, and dashed-ring states. Focus and route planning leave the current location unchanged.

limitations: The forest and moth spirit are original generated references; no Ori character or exact game environment is included.
Blind Forest UI research is excluded as evidence for Will of the Wisps.
Synthetic state must be wired to product data.
